Jessica (AE): hey team, new POC for FinLedger — they asked if we can guarantee control-plane signaling stays in EU and data never leaves eu-west-1 for inference traffic :wave; need ops + legal input
Mike (Presales): quick summary of ask? is it BYOK + EU-only routing or just control-plane?
Jessica (AE): both. BYOK for keys, and a hard preference for inference egress staying in eu-west-1. fallback allowed to eu-central only if eu-west degraded, but customer wants visibility into routing decisions
Derek (Infra): ok. runtime supports region pinning per-tenant. we can set routing policy `region_prefer: eu-west-1` + `failover: eu-central-1` with strict logging. need to confirm subprocessor list for eu-west infra though
Priya (Legal): we'll need a subprocessor attestation and updated DPA clause. which CSP are we using for eu-west?
Derek (Infra): primary infra is CloudProviderZ (eu-west-1), backup is CloudProviderZ eu-central, plus edge caching in partner PoP (PartnerEdge EU). subprocessors: [CloudProviderZ, PartnerEdge]. Can produce the standard subproc attestation doc, but PartnerEdge is a small CDN partner — finsight may ask for SOC2 proof
Mike (Presales): can we enable BYOK with HSM routing to their KMS? customer asked for HSM-backed keys in their Azure tenant (they use BYOK/HSM in their tenant)
Derek (Infra): we support BYOK via KMS integration. we have two options: 1) bring-your-own-key with CloudProviderZ KMS federation, or 2) customer rotates keys via our key-proxy (customer-managed). HSM-handshake with external HSM requires enterprise private deployment — can propose Dedicated or Private for that requirement
Jessica (AE): pricing question: how much uplift for Dedicated vs hosted w/ BYOK + region pinning? customer expects cost delta breakdown for QBR tomorrow
Derek (Infra): short answer: hosted + BYOK (federated) = ~5% premium on token rates for key wrapping + per-tenant routing. Dedicated w/ HSM = fixed monthly reserved infra + 20-30% uplift depending on cluster size. i'll add numbers and an example calc in a follow-up
Priya (Legal): also flag: routing logs must include per-request region decision + subproc chain for compliance. we can provide logs but retention and redaction policy need to be negotiated (they asked for 7 years)
Jessica (AE): they asked for a sample runbook for the POC: steps, acceptance criteria (no cross-border egress observed in a 48h pass), and contact points — can we produce that by EOD?
Derek (Infra): yes. i'll draft a POC runbook with traffic capture commands and the query to validate `x-routing-region` header on responses. Example check: `grep "x-routing-region" /var/log/inference-access.log | awk '{print $2}' | sort | uniq` to show all routing regions used
Mike (Presales): also include the fallback policy test: simulate eu-west saturation and show failover to eu-central with timestamps and alerting in console
ops-bot: automated note: a presales escalations ticket has been opened (ESC-7894) and assigned to Derek.
Priya (Legal): i'll start the subprocessor attestation request template and the DPA amendment. can you share exact PartnerEdge contact?
Jessica (AE): PartnerEdge contact is laura@partneredge.eu — i'll intro via email after we have the runbook. can we have the pricing delta + runbook + subproc attestation draft by EOD PST?
Derek (Infra): i'll put draft pricing table and runbook in the shared drive and ping here when ready — ETA 6 hours.
Mike (Presales): i'll prepare a short slide for tomorrow's call with the tech diagram showing routing policy and BYOK options
Jessica (AE): perfect, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Priya (Legal): noted — will review drafts once Derek posts them. if PartnerEdge cannot provide SOC2, pitching Dedicated or Private may be a blocker
Jessica (AE): noted. closing loop — tagging @mike for slides, @derek for runbook/pricing, @priya for legal. will send intro to customer after we have the artifacts.
